question: Bhagoria is a festival associated with which of the following festivals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Holi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhagoria** is a festival associated with **Holi**.
 
• It is celebrated by the **tribal communities**, mainly the Bhils and the Bhilalas, in the **Indian state of Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• The festival is marked by traditional dances, songs, and cultural performances.
 
• **Bhagoria** festival is also known for its **unique matchmaking tradition**, where young men and women choose their life partners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 Dussehra, also known as **Vijayadashami**, commemorates the victory of Lord Rama over the demon king Ravana, symbolizing the triumph of righteousness over evil.

 Holi
 Holi, also known as the **Festival of Colors**, celebrates the arrival of spring and the end of winter. It is celebrated by people throwing colored powders and water at each other.

 Lord Shiva
 **Maha Shivaratri** is a Hindu festival celebrated annually in honor of Lord Shiva. It marks the convergence of Shiva and Shakti, symbolizing the cosmic dance of creation, preservation, and destruction.
